caption:
Why I build my personal brand, not just my business.

There are hundreds of companies that do what we do. People come to me because of how I treat them.

Do the same with your content. Show the owner. Show the clients. Make characters out of your employees.

Someone told me yesterday, "I don't trust a lot of people, but I trust you." That's the whole point.

DM me REAL and I'll send you the 3 videos every owner should film with their own face.
